title: ReviewDecision
description: A person's decision about a finding. It is an assertion, not a measurement: a retest can disagree with it, and both stay on the record. `reason` classifies a false positive. `expiresAt` applies only to `accepted`: the finding opens again at that time.

reason.description: `not_reachable`: not reachable in production. `validated_upstream`: the input is validated before it arrives. `mitigated`: a control elsewhere stops it, for example a WAF, authentication or the network. `wrong_claim`: the code does not do what the finding says. `duplicate`: another finding states the same weakness.
